content:
BUILT CoLAB is promoting a Training Course on LCA – Life Cycle Assessment (Introductory Level) which will take place in May and is aimed at professionals in the AEC sector, working in SMEs, Start-ups or Public Administration Entities.

There will be a total of 8 hours of training, spread over four 2-hour synchronous online sessions, which will provide an introduction to LCA methodology in construction, covering a systemic view of products/services, prioritisation and trade-offs, evaluation in decision-making and practical application of the methodology in case studies. It also includes the study of life cycle assessment methodology, the use of tools to solve environmental problems and the formulation of hypotheses.

Detailed information, access conditions and registration form* available here.

This Training Action takes place as part of the DIGITALBuilt – European Digital Innovation Hub, which BUILT CoLAB is a part of, enabling organisations to find solutions that promote their digitalisation at more affordable prices, as it includes co-financing from the PRR and the European Union.

* Registration deadline: 16 April.
